verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering legal services such as transactions, funds, notary work and transparency-register filings. An interactive API reference with runnable examples is outside the scope of a professional-services firm of this kind. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and nothing in the pack shows YPOG ships a developer API, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
